snapshotConsistency: per-case stable checkpoint snapshots; cases read sequentially
accountingNotes: Recorded checkpoint usage is known received normalized accounting; zeros do not resolve requests with missing usage.
Raw request usage retains null for absent fields; reasoning_tokens is a count only.
Provider response IDs are included only when actually archived; successful response logs may not contain them.
Coordinator acceptance and approved artifacts do not change the model session phase.
Messages, tool inputs/results, source text, private reasoning/signatures, free-form diagnostics, credentials and runtime paths are excluded.
